name: PFPA target-gradient block selection
source_anchor_objective: per-batch mean cross-entropy over present classes; ignore label 255; average batches

candidate_scores.P_theta: L2 norm of candidate block parameters
candidate_scores.P_g: L2 norm of target-objective gradient for candidate block

conflict_projection: If the dot product of target and source-anchor gradients is negative, remove the target-gradient component along the source-anchor gradient; otherwise retain the target gradient.
update: One gradient-descent update on one encoder transformer block, normalized to the configured relative parameter displacement; no optimizer steps.

SegFormer-B0.evaluation: native-label resolution in the retained historical pipeline

Swin-T + UPerNet.evaluation: 512x512 labels in the retained historical pipeline

evaluation_note: Target-validation metrics are descriptive post-hoc utility in the retained development record; they are not used for target-gradient scoring or the parameter update.
